title: Ray-finned fishes: spot the Critically Endangered
intro: Conservation status of ray-finned fishes, using the IUCN Red List categories as recorded on Wikidata.

questions.prompt: Which of these species is recorded as Critically Endangered?
questions.explain: Beluga: Critically Endangered. black ghost knifefish: Least Concern; Big-mouth Gulper: Least Concern; Largehead hairtail: Least Concern. Status as recorded on Wikidata (IUCN Red List categories), retrieved 2026-10-12.
